support_policy_note: The nominal polar-angle distribution is conditional on measured Table-VI support. Zero probability outside that theta support is a declared reference-model choice, not evidence that the physical cross section vanishes there. Alternate source-bound support/extrapolation models remain a required sensitivity under issue #1178.
azimuth_policy_note: The reference source samples full physical azimuth with no detector-surrogate pre-acceptance. Detector geometry and trigger logic determine downstream acceptance. The historical 5 cm / 1 m narrow-phi proposal remains non-authorising for total rates or general angular distributions without an explicit proposal/target measure treatment.
uncertainty_note: Central values only. Statistical and systematic cross-section nuisance propagation remains issue #1179.
validation_note: Deterministic interval inverse, source-byte checks, and static/deterministic full-azimuth source-contract checks are repository-tested. A compiled Geant4 build, seeded generator-level closure, full-phi versus any importance-sampled accepted-observable closure, production run manifest serialization, and detector-response propagation remain required before authorising physical claims.

hard_coded_detector_surrogate_phi_preacc.historical_mechanism: 5 cm detector height / 1 m distance => phi_max = atan2(0.025, 1)
